specs.Compatible Processors: AMD Ryzen 9000, AMD Ryzen 8000, AMD Ryzen 7000

features: SUPPORTS THE RYZEN 9000 PROCESSORS IN HIGH PERFORMANCE - The PRO A620AM-G EVO WIFI is a compact M-ATX motherboard outfitted with the AMD A620A chipset (AM5, Ryzen 9000 / 8000 / 7000); The VRM features MSI Core Boost technology for improved stability
PASSIVE & AI COOLING - A chipset heatsink provides passive cooling; Frozr AI cooling automatically adjusts system fan settings based on CPU & GPU temperatures

DDR5 MEMORY, PCIe 4.0 x16 SLOT - 2 x DDR5 DIMM slots with Memory Boost isolated circuitry for overclocking (1DPC 1R, 7200+ MT/s); Primary PCIe x16 slot supports PCIe 4.0 (64GB/s) and includes Steel Armor
GEN4 M.2 CONNECTORS - Storage options include 2 x M.2 Gen4 x4 64Gbps slot for hyper-fast SSD access
WIFI6E CONNECTIVITY - Network hardware includes a Wi-Fi 6E module with Bluetooth 5.3 & 2.5Gbps LAN; Rear ports include USB 5Gbps Type-A, HDMI 2.1 and DP 1.4, and 7.1 HD Audio with Audio Boost
